_comment: Station yields measured outside this pipeline. Edit this file; nothing
WST and FT are Sigurd's and arrive by message, so they have nowhere to
come from automatically. Put the figure here with the day it describes.
yield: a fraction, not a percent. 0.353 is 35.3%.
asOf:  the day the figure describes, not the day it was typed.
source: who said so. It is printed next to the number.
A figure is CARRIED FORWARD onto later windows for up to 21 days and
marked as carried, because 'no new update' is a normal week and a dash
would read as 'there is no such measurement'. It is never carried
backward onto an earlier window, and after 21 days it stops being shown
at all — see build_fpy._external_in. So leaving an entry alone is the
right thing to do when nobody reported a new one; it does not need
touching until the figure itself changes.

wst.note: Wafer sort. Average across the two lots.
